value.rationale: The invariant is the exact mixed fourth Fourier correlation between two natural low-degree polynomial graphs, a bilinear restriction quantity not determined by either single-curve self-energy. The even-quartic parameter is the canonical even quartic deformation, and the first genus-one branch in a low-degree mixed collision produces a nontrivial elliptic Frobenius trace with explicit exceptional-point corrections. Its undeformed case has a sharp three-regime mod-twelve law, not a textbook self-energy or arbitrary small numerical slice. The formula holds for all finite fields and every deformation parameter.
